sloka: अथवा वासवेन त्वं धर्षितो ऽसि महाबल ।वासवस्य कुतः शक्तिस्त्वां द्रष्टुमपि संयुगे ।। ६.११४.१३ ।।
transliteration: athavā vāsavena tvaṁ dharṣito 'si mahābala ।vāsavasya kutaḥ śaktistvāṁ draṣṭumapi saṁyuge ।। 6.114.13 ।।

translations.english: "Or else O king of extraordinary might! Indra would have come to overthrow you in the form of Rama. Indra has no energy even to look at you in the battlefield."
translations.hindi: व्योमनाथ, तमोभेदी, ऋगयजु-साम-पारग, घनत्रृष्टि , उप्रपां मित्र, विन्ध्यवी थी, सवङ्गम
